news.title: Rockets' Marcus Smart suspended three games for punch
news.text: The NBA on Thursday suspended Rockets guard Marcus Smart three games without pay for throwing a punch at Warriors center Charles Bassey.

news.title: Warriors' Stephen Curry out at least 2 weeks with oblique tear
news.text: Stephen Curry will miss at least two weeks with an oblique abdominal tear, but sources told ESPN that the Warriors are bracing for him to be out closer to a month.

news.title: Rockets beat Warriors 115-108 to end Golden State’s 8-game winning streak after Curry's early exit
news.text: — Kevin Durant scored 20 points, Alperen Sengun and Amen Thompson added 19 and the Houston Rockets snapped Golden State’s eight-game winning streak with a 115-108 victory on Wednesday night.

news.title: Rockets' Marcus Smart ejected for throwing punch at Warriors' Charles Bassey
news.text: Rockets guard Marcus Smart threw a right hook Wednesday night that grazed the nose of Warriors center Charles Bassey in the third quarter of Houston's win.

news.title: Stephen Curry hurts abdomen, heads for MRI with Warriors' concern level 'high'
news.text: Stephen Curry injured his right abdomen in the first quarter, with Steve Kerr saying after the game that the "concern is high" as they await test results.

news.title: Golden State Warriors guard Will Richard sidelined with torn ligament in thumb
news.text: Second-year Golden State Warriors guard Will Richard, who has been providing key minutes as both a starter and a reserve, has a torn ligament in his left thumb that will sideline him for an undetermined stretch.

news.title: Stephen Curry's latest history-making night keeps Warriors rolling
news.text: Warriors star Stephen Curry scored 17 of his 41 points in the final seven minutes of a 126-119 overtime win over the Magic, setting another late-career NBA record.
